title: The Painted Inheritance
author: Felix Ravensworth
blurb: Bram Marchetti, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
